result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom navigation all render correctly. The partially visible carousel item at the right edge ('Trattoria Piccol...') and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are expected scroll behaviors and not defects. One minor visual inconsistency remains: a partially visible category chip at the far right edge of the filter row appears as an empty sliver with no visible label, which reads as an unfinished element rather than an intentional peek affordance.

issues.description: At the right edge of the category filter chip row, a partially visible chip shows only an empty gray sliver with no readable label, making it look like a rendering artifact or empty element rather than a scrollable next category.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the next chip in the horizontally scrollable row peeks with enough width to show part of its label (or add a fade/scroll indicator), so users perceive it as scrollable content instead of a broken empty chip.
